cannot.what: invent plausible new content: 'It can't create new detail like diffusion can, but it's much faster' (Comfy template)
temporal coherence: per-frame, no temporal model -> shimmer on video; the real fix is SeedVR2 (native) or FlashVSR (pack)
a scale other than the model's fixed one: 'Model determines output size - 2x models upscale 2x, 4x models upscale 4x' (resize after)

community_alternatives.what: ssitu/ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale: tiled img2img over an ESRGAN pre-upscale. Nodes UltimateSDUpscale ('Ultimate SD Upscale'), UltimateSDUpscaleNoUpscale, UltimateSDUpscaleCustomSample, UltimateSDUpscaleGuider; takes upscale_model (UPSCALE_MODEL). Defaults: upscale_by 2 (0.05-4 step 0.05), steps 20, cfg 8.0, denoise 0.2, mode_type Linear|Chess|None, tile 512x512, mask_blur 8, tile_padding 32, seam_fix_mode None|Band Pass|Half Tile|Half Tile + Intersections, seam_fix_denoise 1.0, seam_fix_width 64, seam_fix_mask_blur 8, seam_fix_padding 16, force_uniform_tiles True, tiled_decode False. Tile 1024 for SDXL is community practice (no official statement - NOT FOUND).

diffusion upscalers in Comfy templates that are NOT this family: SUPIR (utility_image_upscale_supir: ModelPatchLoader SUPIR-v0Q_fp16 -> SUPIRApply -> SDXL), PiD (utility_pid_latent_upscale_dit), Z-Image-Turbo 2K upscaler, Wan 2.2 video upscale (utility_video_upscale, kijai WanVideoWrapper nodes, denoise 0.10-0.20 'detail preserving' / 0.20-0.30 'creative'), SeedVR2 (own profile)

selection.why: RealESRGAN_x4plus: the official template default, 64 MB, fast; swap the port for Remacri / Nomos DAT / SwinIR-realSR when fidelity matters more than speed
docs.comfy.org: UltraSharp for AI-generated renders; 'lots and lots of detail'
UltraSharpV2 (DAT2): 'realistic images, anime, cartoons' in one model
selection.tradeoff: transformer = several times slower than ESRGAN

selection.why: the downscale-after pattern: 4x model then ImageScaleBy 0.5 (template tip); averages GAN noise
the official 'Video Upscale: Real-ESRGAN' template: fastest video upscale; per-frame
selection.tradeoff: shimmer: prefer SeedVR2 for anything that must stay temporally coherent

selection.why: 4x -> 2x supersample averages per-frame noise (community-confirmed shimmer mitigation)
the official 2-pass txt2img: LatentUpscale 1.5x + second KSampler denoise 0.5 - no extra model, spliced after any sampler
selection.tradeoff: latent interpolation is blurry: needs denoise ~0.5

selection.why: the official non-latent upscaling: ESRGAN 4x -> resize to target -> VAEEncode -> KSampler denoise 0.5; sharper base, so lower denoise is plausible
an exact width x height with no model (scale + centre crop): the last step when no earlier stage sets the delivery size

params.name: model scale
params.meaning: the model fixes the factor: 1x / 2x / 4x (8x SwinIR exists); ImageUpscaleWithModel reads upscale_model.scale
params.interactions: to hit 2x with a 4x model add ImageScaleBy 0.5 (or ImageScale to the target) after - template tip; chaining 2x -> 4x is also documented (docs)

params.name: tiling (internal)
params.meaning: tile 512, overlap 32; on OOM tile //= 2 until < 128 raises
params.interactions: not user-exposed; any size works through tiles; speed is the limit, not VRAM

params.name: downscale after
params.meaning: supersample-then-downscale averages GAN noise (and per-frame shimmer on video)
params.interactions: ResizeImageMaskNode tooltip: 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling; ImageScale width/height 0 = keep aspect from the other side

params.name: hires-fix denoise
params.meaning: how much the second pass re-draws
params.interactions: latent path needs ~0.5 to repair interpolation blur; the ESRGAN pixel path starts sharp so lower is plausible (no official number - NOT FOUND); higher = more new detail / structure drift

params.name: hires-fix upscale factor
params.interactions: LatentUpscale width/height are pixel sizes in steps of 8; methods nearest-exact|bilinear|area|bicubic|bislerp (bislerp is latent-only)

params.name: pass-2 sampler
params.interactions: both official examples reuse pass 1's positive/negative; the third example swaps checkpoint and prompt

params.name: ImageScaleToTotalPixels / ImageScaleToMaxDimension
params.interactions: docs use ImageScaleToTotalPixels 0.35 Mpx to pre-shrink before a diffusion upscaler

rules.message: 'Model determines output size - 2x models upscale 2x, 4x models upscale 4x'. A target that is not the model's scale needs a resize node after ImageUpscaleWithModel ('Upscale 4x first, then use a resize node to bring it down to your target resolution')

per-frame GAN upscaling has no temporal model: 'ESRGAN upscalers are per-frame with no temporal awareness - so they can shimmer on video'. Acceptable for a quick preview; for a deliverable prefer SeedVR2 (native, temporally coherent) or at least the 4x -> 2x supersample (upscale-video-frames-2x)

classicalSR SwinIR, the DAT / HAT research pretrains and 4xLSDIR were trained WITHOUT degradations (bicubic-downscaled inputs only): on JPEG, noisy or blurry sources use a realSR / Nomos / RealESRGAN model instead

UltraSharp-class models 'generate lots and lots of detail' and can oversharpen / halo an already-sharp AI image; fix generation issues first (docs), or use RealESRGAN_x4plus / Nomos / SwinIR-realSR for a softer result
after a latent upscale the interpolated latent is blurry: the official examples run the second pass at denoise 0.5 (0.35 in the different-prompt example); below that the softness stays
LatentUpscale width/height are pixel sizes in steps of 8

'Since ESRGAN operates in pixel space the image must be converted to pixel space and back to latent space after being upscaled' - a second sampler pass after an ESRGAN upscale needs VAEEncode in between
per-frame upscaling keeps the frame count: CreateVideo.fps must be wired from GetVideoComponents (the template links fps and audio through) or the clip changes speed
UpscaleModelLoader rejects face-restoration / inpainting / denoise checkpoints that spandrel recognises: 'Upscale model must be a single-image model.'
the GAN video template needs 0.3.31 (LoadVideo / GetVideoComponents / CreateVideo / SaveVideo); the archived hires-fix examples carry no minimum

prompting.note: classic upscalers take no prompt. In a hires fix the second KSampler reuses the first pass's positive/negative (both official examples) or a different prompt/checkpoint (the third example). For UltimateSDUpscale the tile prompt is the global prompt; no per-tile captioning in the base pack.

pitfalls.fix: 4x then ImageScaleBy 0.5 (averages noise); for a real fix SeedVR2 or FlashVSR

pitfalls.symptom: 'Upscale model must be a single-image model.'
pitfalls.cause: a face-restoration / inpainting / denoise checkpoint spandrel recognises but the loader rejects
spandrel does not know the arch, or it needs the extra package

pitfalls.fix: ImageScaleBy 0.5 / ImageScale after (template tip) or a 2x model (RealESRGAN_x2plus, 2x-AnimeSharpV4, SwinIR x2)

pitfalls.cause: UltraSharp-class model on an already-sharp render
pitfalls.fix: RealESRGAN_x4plus, Nomos DAT or SwinIR-realSR; fix the generation first

pitfalls.symptom: artifacts amplified on a JPEG / noisy source
pitfalls.cause: a clean-input-only model (classicalSR SwinIR, DAT/HAT pretrains, 4xLSDIR)

denoise ~0.5 after LatentUpscale (official examples); or the ESRGAN pixel path
